answer.answer: No specific dataset was provided, and published Mediterranean microplastic surveys vary widely in sampling depth, mesh size, and quantification method even when geographically close, making a single median 'factor' between paired samples unsupportable from memory. Reported concentration ranges across studies span orders of magnitude (often 10-100x) due to methodological differences rather than a well-defined replicate comparison.
